title: Step 1: Project Setup and Directory Structure
description: Create docs_app directory with Flutter project, configure pubspec.yaml with dependencies (provider, go_router, flutter_highlight, etc.), set up directory structure (lib/core, lib/shared, lib/pages, lib/data), configure web/index.html for GitHub Pages

title: Step 2: Documentation Website Foundation
description: Create app shell with DocumentationShell widget (header, sidebar, footer), basic navigation structure, theme-aware layout using IosAnimatedTheme

title: Step 3: Core Component Preview System
description: Build ComponentPreview widget with variation/state controls, create supporting models (PreviewConfig, ComponentVariation, ComponentState), implement preview canvas with isolated theme

title: Step 4: Theme Provider and Switching
description: Implement DocumentationThemeProvider with SharedPreferences persistence, create ThemeToggleButton widget, integrate theme toggle in header

title: Step 5: Navigation and Routing
description: Set up go_router configuration, define navigation structure with all routes, implement NavigationSidebar with collapsible sections and active state

title: Step 6: Code Display and Syntax Highlighting
description: Create CodeBlock widget with flutter_highlight for syntax highlighting, implement copy-to-clipboard functionality, support for Dart/Flutter code with proper theming
